parameters.autofocus: Whether the control takes focus when it first appears.
parameters.title: The primary heading.
parameters.subtitle: Supporting text displayed with the primary content.
parameters.child: The content placed inside this component.
parameters.initiallyExpanded: The initial open state when expanded is not controlled.
parameters.expanded: The controlled open state, or null to keep local state.
parameters.onExpansionChanged: Reports when the user requests a different open state.
parameters.enabled: Whether the control accepts user interaction.
parameters.isFirst: Whether this is the first row, without a preceding separator.
parameters.focusNode: An optional externally owned focus node.
